functions.name: random
functions.description: Random decimal number between min and max

functions.name: loopindex
functions.description: Current number of the loop called "i" (For loop), or of the innermost loop without a name

functions.name: randomInt
functions.description: Random whole number from min to max (inclusive)

functions.name: choose
functions.description: Picks one of the values at random

functions.name: abs
functions.description: Absolute value (removes the minus sign)

functions.name: min
functions.description: Smallest value

functions.name: max
functions.description: Largest value

functions.name: floor
functions.description: Round down

functions.name: ceil
functions.description: Round up

functions.name: round
functions.description: Round to nearest (optionally to N decimals)

functions.name: sqrt
functions.description: Square root

functions.name: pow
functions.description: x to the power of y (same as x ^ y)

functions.name: hypot
functions.description: Length of a vector: sqrt(a² + b² + …), e.g. hypot(vx, vz) is the speed

functions.name: sin
functions.description: Sine (angle in degrees)

functions.name: cos
functions.description: Cosine (angle in degrees)

functions.name: tan
functions.description: Tangent (angle in degrees)

functions.name: atan2
functions.description: Angle in degrees of the vector (x, y)

functions.name: angle
functions.description: Angle (degrees, around Y) from point 1 to point 2

functions.name: lerp
functions.description: Blend from a to b (t from 0 to 1)

functions.name: clamp
functions.description: Keep x between min and max

functions.name: distance
functions.description: Distance on the ground (X/Z) between two points

functions.name: distance3
functions.signature: distance3(x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2)
functions.description: 3D distance between two points

functions.name: int
functions.description: Whole number part (drops decimals)

functions.name: float
functions.description: Convert text to a number

functions.name: str
functions.description: Convert a number to text

functions.name: len
functions.description: Number of characters in a text

functions.name: upper
functions.description: UPPERCASE text

functions.name: lower
functions.description: lowercase text

functions.name: left
functions.description: First characters of a text

functions.name: right
functions.description: Last characters of a text

functions.name: mid
functions.description: Part of a text

functions.name: contains
functions.description: true if text contains part

functions.name: replace
functions.description: Replace every occurrence

functions.name: pad
functions.description: Pad with leading zeros, e.g. 007

functions.name: table
functions.description: A cell of a data table: the table, the row name, the column

functions.name: t
functions.description: A text from Files → Localization in the current language; {0}, {1} in it are filled by extra arguments: t("score", points)

functions.name: tablerow
functions.description: The name of a row of a data table by number (0 is the first), to go through every row with a loop

functions.name: achievementcount
functions.description: How many achievements Files → Services has (to go through them with a loop)

functions.name: achievementid
functions.description: The id of an achievement by number (0 is the first)

functions.name: achievementname
functions.description: The name of an achievement, by number or id

functions.name: achievementsteps
functions.description: Steps done of an achievement (all of them once unlocked)

functions.name: achievementgoal
functions.description: Steps an achievement needs (1 for a plain one)

functions.name: achievementdone
functions.description: 1 when the achievement is unlocked, else 0

functions.name: bestscore
functions.description: The best score sent to a leaderboard from this device (0 when none)

functions.name: productprice
functions.description: The price text of a product, e.g. "$1.99"

functions.name: netcode
functions.description: The code of the room you are in (give it to friends so they can join); empty when not in a room

functions.name: netishost
functions.description: 1 when you are the host of the room (the player who has been in it the longest), else 0

functions.name: netonline
functions.description: 1 when you are in a room, else 0

functions.name: netplayers
functions.description: How many players are in the room, you included

functions.name: netplayername
functions.description: The name of a player by number (0 is the first to have joined); use with a loop

functions.name: netplayerid
functions.description: The id of a player by number (0 is the first to have joined)

functions.name: netmyname
functions.description: Your name in the room

functions.name: netmyid
functions.description: Your id in the room (0 when not in one)

functions.name: nethostname
functions.description: The name of the host

functions.name: netwho
functions.description: In "On player joined", "On player left" and "On message": the name of that player

functions.name: netwhoid
functions.description: In "On player joined", "On player left" and "On message": the id of that player

functions.name: netmessage
functions.description: The name of the latest message received

functions.name: netdata
functions.description: In "On message": what the message carries. Without a name it is the whole value; with one it is that part of an object ("x" or "pos.z")

functions.name: neterror
functions.description: In "On room failed": why (notfound, full, busy or offline)

functions.name: webstatus
functions.description: In "On web response" / "On web error": the status code of the reply (200, 404…; 0 when no reply came)

functions.name: webok
functions.description: 1 when the latest web request got a 2xx reply, else 0

functions.name: webtext
functions.description: The reply of the latest web request as text

functions.name: webjson
functions.description: A value inside the JSON reply of the latest web request: dots go into objects, numbers pick from lists. Empty when it is not there

functions.name: webjsoncount
functions.description: How many items the list (or keys the object) at that place in the JSON reply has

functions.name: weberror
functions.description: In "On web error": what went wrong, in words

functions.name: webname
functions.description: The name given to the request that the latest reply answers

functions.name: rayhitname
functions.description: After a "Raycast" condition: the name of the object the ray hit (empty when nothing)

functions.name: tablecount
functions.description: How many rows a data table has

functions.name: time
functions.description: Seconds since the scene started

functions.name: dt
functions.description: Seconds since the last frame (multiply speeds by dt)

functions.name: fps
functions.description: Frames per second

functions.name: loadingProgress
functions.description: On a loading screen: how far it got, 0 to 1 (for a loading bar). It is 1 exactly when the game is ready to leave the screen

functions.name: loopIndex
functions.description: Current number of the innermost loop (Repeat, For, For each, While)

functions.name: screenWidth
functions.description: Screen width in pixels

functions.name: screenHeight
functions.description: Screen height in pixels

functions.name: touchX
functions.description: Finger X position on screen

functions.name: touchY
functions.description: Finger Y position on screen

functions.name: touchWorldX
functions.description: X of the spot in the world under the finger / mouse (the ground or an object)

functions.name: touchWorldY
functions.description: Y (height) of the spot in the world under the finger / mouse

functions.name: touchWorldZ
functions.description: Z of the spot in the world under the finger / mouse

functions.name: hitX
functions.description: In "On collision with" or "Is touching": X of the point where they touched

functions.name: hitY
functions.description: In "On collision with" or "Is touching": Y (height) of the point where they touched

functions.name: hitZ
functions.description: In "On collision with" or "Is touching": Z of the point where they touched

functions.name: hitNormalX
functions.description: In "On collision with" or "Is touching": X of the surface direction at the hit, pointing out of the other object toward this one

functions.name: hitNormalY
functions.description: In "On collision with" or "Is touching": Y of the surface direction at the hit (1 = landed on top of the other object, -1 = hit it from below)

functions.name: hitNormalZ
functions.description: In "On collision with" or "Is touching": Z of the surface direction at the hit

functions.name: hitSpeed
functions.description: In "On collision with" or "Is touching": how fast they hit each other (m/s), e.g. damage or a sound volume

functions.name: rayHitX
functions.description: After a "Raycast" condition: X of the point the ray hit

functions.name: rayHitY
functions.description: After a "Raycast" condition: Y (height) of the point the ray hit

functions.name: rayHitZ
functions.description: After a "Raycast" condition: Z of the point the ray hit

functions.name: rayNormalX
functions.description: After a "Raycast" condition: X of the direction the hit surface faces

functions.name: rayNormalY
functions.description: After a "Raycast" condition: Y of the direction the hit surface faces (1 = flat ground)

functions.name: rayNormalZ
functions.description: After a "Raycast" condition: Z of the direction the hit surface faces

functions.name: rayDistance
functions.description: After a "Raycast" condition: how far the ray travelled before it hit (meters)

functions.name: hitImpulse
functions.description: In "On collision with" or "Is touching": how hard the physics pushed them apart (N·s); 0 for triggers (hitX/Y/Z and the surface direction are only estimated there)

functions.name: joystickX
functions.description: Joystick left/right (-1 to 1)

functions.name: joystickY
functions.description: Joystick down/up (-1 to 1)

functions.name: lookX
functions.description: Mouse / right stick / drag turn this frame, in degrees (right = positive)

functions.name: lookY
functions.description: Mouse / right stick / drag tilt this frame, in degrees (up = positive)

objectProps.name: x
objectProps.description: X position (a UI element: its offset from its anchors, what Set position sets)

objectProps.name: y
objectProps.description: Y position, the height (a UI element: its offset from its anchors, Y up)

objectProps.name: count
objectProps.description: Number of these objects in the scene

objectProps.name: pickedCount
objectProps.description: Number of picked instances in this event

objectProps.name: hipsX
objectProps.description: X of the hips of a ragdoll (the object stays put); its own position when not limp

objectProps.name: hipsY
objectProps.description: Y of the hips of a ragdoll

objectProps.name: hipsZ
objectProps.description: Z of the hips of a ragdoll

objectProps.name: width
objectProps.description: Width of a UI element (what Set size sets)

objectProps.name: height
objectProps.description: Height of a UI element (what Set size sets)

objectProps.name: centerX
objectProps.description: UI element: where the MIDDLE of its box is drawn, in canvas px from the left. Use it to put something on top of this element

objectProps.name: centerY
objectProps.description: UI element: where the MIDDLE of its box is drawn, in canvas px from the bottom

objectProps.name: screenX
objectProps.description: UI element: where its PIVOT is drawn, in canvas px from the left, whatever its parent. Use it to place something relative to this element (screenX + 40)

objectProps.name: screenY
objectProps.description: UI element: where its PIVOT is drawn, in canvas px from the bottom
